_comment: Zincblende GaAs with spin-orbit coupling: an nspin=4 H(R) (ABACUS lspinorb, abacus/gaas_soc/INPUT) read from a NextHam HR_atom_pairs.h5. 'spin': 'spinorbit' makes the basis spinor -- every orbital carries both spin components, interleaved, as ABACUS and NextHam store them -- and H(R) complex; S is built from the .orb files as S (x) I2. The primitive cell is tiled 2x2x2 (16 atoms, 496 spinor orbitals) and sampled on a 2x2x2 mesh, one k-point per rank group. The same run reads ABACUS's own file with format 'abacus' and path 'data/gaas_soc/abacus/data-HR-sparse_SPIN0.csr' once make_data.sh has regenerated it (10 MB, not committed).

orbitals._comment: one per species in ascending atomic number: Ga (31), then As (33)

tasks._comment: The electron count at mid-gap (ABACUS's bands: VBM 7.400 eV, CBM 8.189 eV). Ga and As ONCV-FR carry 13 + 5 valence electrons, so the simulated cell holds 8 x 18 = 144.
Optical conductivity with mu at mid-gap; absorption sets in at the 0.79 eV gap of this PBE basis. g_s = 1: the spinor trace already holds both spins.
